title: Bond Dib loo qoray oo uu qoray Muujintii
intro: Bal qiyaas inaad ku aaminay qof aad muhiim u ah, ka dibna aad wajahayso amar joojinaya xiriirka si aad u addeecdo awgeed. Muujin ayaa dib u qaabaysay guri dhan, magaca ku yaal bartamaha amarkana waligiis lama odhan jirin.
clues: Waxaan taagnaa meeshii daacadnimada shaqsiyeed ay ahayd inay u hoggaansanto addeecidda rabbaaniga ah.
Waxaa la iiga yaqaanay guriga Rasuulka inaan ahay wiil korsaday.
Waxaan ogaaday in guurkaygu uu noqday mowduuc waxyi ah oo loo jeediyay Rasuulka Alle.
Waxaan maqlay ereyada ah, 'Xaaskaaga hayso oo Alle ka cabso,' oo ii soo jeedda.
Dabadeed waxaan ogaaday in Alle uu Rasuulka Alle ku amray inuu furo xaasas gaar ah, guurkayguna uu ku dhammaado amarkaas.
Anigu waxaan ahay Zayd ibn Xaarithah, wiilka la korsaday ee lagu magacaabay suuradda Al-Axzb.

In lagu tuuro foorno dab ah
Ku seexanaya godka dhexdiisa qarniyo badan
trial.answer: In loo sheegay inuu xaaskiisa haysto ka dibna loo sheegay inuu furo

outcome.answer: Wuu addeecay amarka, xaaskiisana wuu furay, guurkiina waa la kala diray

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
